requirement:
修复车次信息查询服务的 bug。
车次信息服务在查询经停车次时返回空数据。
需要检查车次信息与旅行服务之间的数据查询逻辑。

details.name: ts-route-service
details.rationale: Route information is likely queried by ts-travel-service to determine stops, so a bug in querying passing stations may involve route data.

details.name: ts-route-plan-service
details.rationale: This service plans routes and may interact with travel service for stop information, potentially affected by changes in query logic.

details.name: ts-travel2-service
details.rationale: As a related travel service, it may share data models or APIs with ts-travel-service and could be impacted by changes.

details.name: ts-station-service
details.rationale: Station data is essential for determining passing stops, so this service may need updates if query logic changes.

details.name: ts-train-service
details.rationale: Train information is used in travel queries; changes to how stops are queried might involve train data.

details.name: ts-admin-route-service
details.rationale: Admin route service manages route data and could be involved if the bug relates to route configuration.

details.name: ts-admin-travel-service
details.rationale: Admin travel service may manage travel-related data and could be affected by changes in travel query logic.
